check.title: Ensure 'Enable optional updates' is set to 'Disabled'.
check.rationale: Often, new features or enhancements that are enabled by default (before IT administrators are ready to manage them) can negatively impact the user experience or introduce bugs and security risks.
check.description: This policy setting controls whether devices are able to receive optional updates (including Controlled Feature Rollout (CFRs)). These optional updates can include non-security updates, feature enhancements, and other improvements. The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled.
check.remediation: To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to Disabled: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Windows Update\Manage updates offered from Windows Update\Enable optional updates This Group Policy path may not exist by default. It is provided by the Group Policy template WindowsUpdate.admx/adml that is included with the Microsoft Windows 11 Release 23H2 Administrative Templates (or newer).
